pos-displays.heading: POS Displays & Shelving
pos-displays.intro: Corrugated retail displays, stands, and stoppers, built to your campaign spec and delivered ready to deploy.
pos-displays.body:
Retail displays from Skat Print are designed around one goal: getting your product in front of buyers without taking existing shelf space from the retailer. food-packaging.heading: Food Packaging
food-packaging.intro: Cardboard and corrugated packaging that meets food industry quality and safety standards.
food-packaging.body:
Food packaging from Skat Print is built for the practical demands of the food industry, moisture resistance, structural integrity under pressure, food-safe materials, and design that earns the sale at shelf level. specs: Custom sizing for fragile or pressure-sensitive products

alcohol-packaging.heading: Wine & Spirits Packaging
alcohol-packaging.intro: Laminated Bag-in-Box and luxury corrugated packaging built for the alcohol and beverage industry.
alcohol-packaging.body:

Our laminated corrugated packaging carries both print quality and structural integrity. The result is packaging that protects the product and positions the brand.

specs: Luxury laminated boxes with foil and gloss options
Die-cut punch holes and custom shapes
Five-layer corrugated for heavy-duty structural needs
Offset-printed branding and finish applied in-house

cosmetics-packaging.heading: Cosmetics & Perfumery Boxes
cosmetics-packaging.intro: Luxury boxes in cardboard, microcorrugated, and laminated materials, finished to brand specification.
cosmetics-packaging.body:
Cosmetics packaging is where design and precision meet. Skat Print produces luxury boxes for the perfumery and cosmetics sector from cardboard, microcorrugated cardboard, and laminated corrugated materials, with post-printing technologies that enhance both appearance and structural integrity.

Packaging plays a direct role in product selection. We treat every cosmetics box as the primary interface between your product and the buyer: designed with the right finish, the right structure, and the right weight in hand.

Post-printing finishes: matte, gloss, silver foil, gold foil, embossing

custom-packaging.heading: Custom & Gift Packaging
custom-packaging.intro: Non-standard packaging in individual sizes, from exposed corrugated aesthetics to premium laminated gift boxes.
custom-packaging.body:

We work from client briefs and product specifications to produce one-of-a-kind packaging runs for gift boxes, specialty products, and brand-forward packaging strategies.
specs: Individual sizing, no minimum standard dimension
Exposed corrugated outer layer aesthetic available

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about ordering custom packaging from Skat Print.

items.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.answer: Minimum order quantities depend on the product type and configuration. For standard corrugated boxes and packaging, we typically work from 500 units upward. For custom or specialty packaging, we accept smaller runs, contact us with your specification for a precise answer.

items.question: What is the typical production lead time?
items.answer: Standard orders are fulfilled within 10–15 working days from approved design. Custom orders requiring new die-cutting tooling may require 15–20 working days. Rush production is available for select order types, ask when requesting your quote.

items.question: Can you produce non-standard sizes and shapes?
items.answer: Yes. We produce packaging in any dimension with no minimum standard size. Our in-house die-cutting capacity allows for unlimited custom shapes, structural cutouts, and bespoke configurations.

items.question: What printing methods do you use?
items.answer: We use offset printing on Roland (52×74cm) and Heidelberg (71×102cm) presses, the same technology used for high-quality commercial printing. This gives significantly sharper results than flexographic printing on corrugated board.

items.question: Do you offer design and pre-press support?
items.answer: Yes. Our in-house design team can work from your brand guidelines, existing artwork, or brief. We handle file preparation, structural dieline creation, and pre-press for all orders.

items.question: What materials and finishes are available?
items.answer: We work with corrugated board (N, E, B wave and 5-layer), cardboard, and microcorrugated. Available finishes include matte laminate, gloss laminate, silver foil, gold foil, and embossing. All materials are 100% recyclable.

items.question: Do you ship outside Bulgaria?
items.answer: Yes. We supply clients across Europe. Shipping terms and logistics are arranged on a per-order basis. Contact us with your delivery location to discuss options.
